title: The Night Shift
description: Last hour of your shift at a roadside diner. A customer walks in — but the mirror behind the counter shows an empty room.

n1.caption: Rain streaks the diner windows. A man in a grey suit sits at table four — but in the mirror behind the counter, his seat is empty.

choices.label: Walk over and take his order
Keep watching him in the mirror

n2a.caption: Up close he smells of wet earth. He orders coffee, black, and slides a photograph across the table. It is a photo of you, taken tonight.

n2b.caption: In the mirror, the empty seat slowly turns to face you. The real man hasn't moved at all.

n3a.caption: 'You did,' he says. 'Every night at 3:13. You've been bringing me coffee for six years. Tonight you finally looked at the mirror.'

n3b.caption: The kitchen door has no lock — only scratches. Hundreds of them, on the inside, all the same depth, all in the shape of tally marks.

n3c.caption: The mirror shatters. Behind it is not a wall but a dark room — and in it, tables full of people in grey suits, all turning toward you.
